name: Daimon
source:
The "people of the universe" suddenly attack a peaceful town from space! 
The powerful armored machines are opposed by a colorful bunch of strange girls. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
来自宇宙的“宇宙人”突然自太空袭击平静小镇！
一群五彩斑斓的怪女孩驾驶着强力装甲机器迎战。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
